title: 哈姆雷特 5-1 墓園骷髏
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, cold gothic atmosphere
characters: Hamlet, a lean young prince dressed head to toe in black, a short dark cloak, tousled dark hair, pale clean-shaven face with shadowed sleepless eyes

panels.prompt: a hillside churchyard with leaning gravestones and a bare yew tree, a grizzled gravedigger waist-deep in an open grave tossing out earth and old bones, whistling, his spade flashing

dialogue.speaker: 掘墓人
dialogue.text: （唱）一把鋤頭一把鍬，一件屍衣把身包；挖一個土坑深又深，來了個客人剛剛好。
dialogue.en: (sings) A pick-axe, and a spade, a spade, for and a shrouding sheet: O, a pit of clay for to be made for such a guest is meet.

panels.prompt: {characters} and Horatio, a sober young scholar in a plain dark scholar's gown with a high collar, short neatly combed brown hair, a small leather book at his belt, approaching along the churchyard wall, the prince tilting his head at the singing from the grave

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 這傢伙一邊掘墳一邊唱歌——他不覺得這工作悲哀嗎？
dialogue.en: Has this fellow no feeling of his business, that he sings at grave-making?

dialogue.speaker: 霍拉旭
dialogue.en: Custom hath made it in him a property of easiness.

panels.prompt: the gravedigger flipping a yellowed skull up out of the grave with his spade, {characters} catching it against his chest with mild surprise

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 這個骷髏也許是個律師。他的狡辯、他的訟案、他的產業條款——現在都到哪裡去了？
dialogue.en: Why may not that be the skull of a lawyer? Where be his quiddities now, his quillets, his cases, his tenures, and his tricks?

panels.prompt: the grizzled gravedigger leaning on his spade at the grave's edge, jerking a thumb at the skull in the prince's hands, grinning with missing teeth

dialogue.speaker: 掘墓人
dialogue.text: 這一個啊，先生——是郁利克的骷髏，先王的弄人。在土裡躺了二十三年了。
dialogue.en: This same skull, sir, was Yorick's skull, the king's jester... Here's a skull now; this skull has lain in the earth three and twenty years.

panels.prompt: macro shot filling the frame: a yellowed cracked human skull resting in an upturned black leather glove, hollow eye sockets staring at the viewer, jaw missing several teeth, loose grave-earth and a rusted spade blade blurred in the background, cold morning light

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 唉，可憐的郁利克！霍拉旭，我認識他——他有取之不竭的詼諧，背過我一千次。你的笑話呢？你的歌呢？現在，你還會嘲笑你自己的獰笑嗎？
dialogue.en: Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio: a fellow of infinite jest, of most excellent fancy: he hath borne me on his back a thousand times... Where be your gibes now? your gambols? your songs?... Not one now, to mock your own grinning?

panels.prompt: close-up of the skull set gently on a flat gravestone, the prince's gloved hand resting on it a moment, dead leaves blowing past

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 凱撒死了，變成泥土——也許哪一天，會拿去堵一個酒桶的口。
dialogue.en: Imperious Caesar, dead and turn'd to clay, might stop a hole to keep the wind away.

panels.prompt: a funeral procession winding into the churchyard — a priest, a flower-strewn bier, King Claudius, a broad heavyset king with a neatly trimmed dark pointed beard, a wide gold crown, fur-trimmed brocade robes, a jeweled goblet in hand, Queen Gertrude, a stately middle-aged queen with coiled auburn braids under a golden circlet, in a layered brocade gown, and Laertes, a hot-blooded young nobleman with short dark curls and a thin moustache, a slender rapier at his hip, a short travel cloak, in mourning — while the prince and the scholar duck behind a yew tree in the foreground

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 是誰的葬禮？儀式這樣簡略——是自己了斷性命的人嗎？瞧，雷歐提斯也在。
dialogue.en: Who is this they follow? And with such maimed rites? This doth betoken the corse they follow did with desperate hand fordo its own life... That is Laertes, a very noble youth: mark.

panels.prompt: Queen Gertrude, a stately middle-aged queen with coiled auburn braids under a golden circlet, in a layered brocade gown, scattering flowers down into the open grave, her face wet

dialogue.speaker: 葛簇特
dialogue.text: 好花是應當散在美人身上的。永別了——我本來希望你做我哈姆雷特的妻子。
dialogue.en: Sweets to the sweet: farewell! I hoped thou shouldst have been my Hamlet's wife.

quote.text: 好花是應當散在美人身上的

panels.prompt: Laertes, a hot-blooded young nobleman with short dark curls and a thin moustache, a slender rapier at his hip, a short travel cloak, leaping down into the open grave, arms raised to catch the shrouded body, earth crumbling from the edges

dialogue.speaker: 雷歐提斯
dialogue.text: 等一等——讓我再抱她一次！現在，把泥土倒在生者和死者身上吧！
dialogue.en: Hold off the earth awhile, till I have caught her once more in mine arms: now pile your dust upon the quick and dead.

panels.prompt: {characters} striding out from behind the yew tree into the middle of the stunned funeral party, cloak thrown back, declaring himself with a raised arm

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 誰的悲哀能有這樣誇張？——我，丹麥王子哈姆雷特在此！
dialogue.en: What is he whose grief bears such an emphasis?... This is I, Hamlet the Dane.

quote.text: 丹麥王子哈姆雷特在此
quote.en: This is I, Hamlet the Dane.

panels.prompt: attendants hauling the prince and the young nobleman apart at the grave's edge, both straining toward each other over the open pit, the priest clutching his book

dialogue.speaker: 哈姆雷特
dialogue.text: 我愛奧菲莉亞——四萬個兄弟的愛加起來，也抵不過我對她的愛！
dialogue.en: I loved Ophelia: forty thousand brothers could not, with all their quantity of love, make up my sum.

quote.text: 四萬個兄弟的愛，也抵不過我
quote.en: Forty thousand brothers could not... make up my sum.

panels.prompt: the mourners dispersing among the gravestones, King Claudius, a broad heavyset king with a neatly trimmed dark pointed beard, a wide gold crown, fur-trimmed brocade robes, a jeweled goblet in hand, drawing the young nobleman aside by the elbow, mouths close, eyes on the departing prince

dialogue.speaker: 克勞地
dialogue.text: 忍耐點，好雷歐提斯——想想我們昨天晚上商量的事。這件事很快就有一個了結。
dialogue.en: Good Laertes... Strengthen your patience in our last night's speech; we'll put the matter to the present push.
